summary: Tested the new Dashboard POS (/pos-dashboard) and checked for regressions. (1) The CI=true production build passes with no warnings or errors. (2) Owner baa logged in through the UI with the two-stage identifier/PIN flow. /pos-dashboard loads with the period filter (Hari Ini, Kemarin, Minggu Ini, Bulan Ini, Bulan Lalu, Manual, plus custom start and end dates) and the Total Tunai, Total QRIS and Total Penjualan cards, which all show Rp 0, and an empty History Penjualan table. (3) Each preset change and each custom date edit fired a new GET /api/reports/sales that returned 200, with no page errors and no error elements. (4) Backend: 18 of 18 tests passed. That is 8 new read-only tests (Owner token, payment sum = revenue = daily sum across ranges of 0, 1, 7, 31 and 62 days, 401/403 without auth, 422 when params are missing) plus 10 regression tests from iter13. (5) Static source check: App.js /pos-dashboard uses REPORT_ACCESS=['owner','admin'] and /pos uses POS_ACCESS=['owner','rider']. The backend REPORTS dependency is roles('owner','admin'). In Layout, the Owner POS menu goes to /pos-dashboard and includes the /pos tab. The Admin POS menu goes to /pos-dashboard and /deposit (no /pos). The Rider POS menu goes to /pos only. Owner can still open /pos and gets the cashier PIN pad. No data was created.

issues: When there are no transactions, the History Penjualan table shows only its headers. Add an empty-state row such as 'Belum ada penjualan'.
There is no loading state, and on API error the catch sets report=null, so the whole dashboard disappears without any message. Show an error toast or text instead.

action_items: Optional: add an empty-state row to the POSDashboard history table and an error/loading state for the /reports/sales fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: POSDashboard.jsx swallows fetch errors (.catch(() => setReport(null))), so the user sees a blank page and no feedback.

The payment lookup uses row.name.toLowerCase() on keys like 'CASH' and 'QRIS'. If the POS stores a method under another name (e.g. 'tunai' or 'transfer'), it counts toward Total Penjualan but not toward the Tunai or QRIS cards. Confirm that the POS saves payment_method exactly as 'cash' or 'qris'.
The backend's to_list(5000) caps long ranges at 5000 sales, so totals could be silently understated for very long periods.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To log in through the UI: set localStorage 'si4am_legal_2026-06-01'='accepted', fill login-identifier-input with 'baa', click login-continue-button, fill pin-digit-0 with '130994', then click pin-continue-button. POS dashboard testids: pos-dashboard-page, pos-dashboard-cash, pos-dashboard-qris, pos-dashboard-sales, pos-dashboard-history, filter-preset-select, filter-custom-start, filter-custom-end. There are no sales in the DB, so all totals are zero. Admin and Rider access was verified from source only.
